documents.title: Meridian Footbridge
documents.body: The Meridian Footbridge spans the Tamsin River between Old Quay and the Foundry District. Construction began in 1984 and the bridge opened to pedestrians in 1987. The deck is 214 metres long and was designed by the engineering cooperative Halden & Roe.

documents.title: Tamsin River Crossings Guide
documents.body: Three crossings link the banks of the Tamsin River. The Calder Rail Bridge was built in 1911 and still carries freight. The Meridian Footbridge, opened in 1987, is pedestrian only. The Glasswing Ferry runs between Old Quay and Saltmarsh Landing.

documents.title: Kestrel Hill Observatory
documents.body: Kestrel Hill Observatory was founded in 1952 on the ridge above Aldermoor. Its main reflecting telescope has an aperture of 1.2 metres. The observatory is directed by Dr. Amara Quill.

documents.title: Kestrel Hill Observatory Annual Report 2025
documents.body: In 2025 the observatory welcomed 48,300 visitors, up from 41,900 the previous year. Director Amara Quill announced a new public outreach wing scheduled to open in 2027.

documents.title: Aldermoor Water Works
documents.body: Aldermoor Water Works was commissioned in 1968 and treats up to 86 million litres of water per day for the Larkspur Valley.

documents.title: Larkspur Valley Transit fares 2026
documents.body: From January 2026 an adult single fare on Larkspur Valley Transit costs 2.40 credits and a day pass costs 6.50 credits. Children under 12 ride free.

documents.title: Larkspur Valley Transit network overview
documents.body: Larkspur Valley Transit has operated trams since 1999. The network has 7 lines and 112 stops, with the Orchard Line being the busiest.

documents.title: Foundry District history
documents.body: The Foundry District grew around the Tamsin Ironworks, which closed in 1979. The district was redeveloped during the 1990s into housing and studios.

documents.title: Larkspur Orchard Festival
documents.body: The Larkspur Orchard Festival is held every September. The 2026 festival runs from 18 to 20 September and features 34 local growers.

documents.title: Larkspur Central Library
documents.body: Larkspur Central Library was founded in 1903 and holds about 410,000 volumes. It is open from 09:00 to 19:00 on weekdays.

documents.title: Glasswing Ferry Service
documents.body: The Glasswing Ferry crosses the Tamsin River from Old Quay to Saltmarsh Landing in 25 minutes. Departures run every 40 minutes using a fleet of 3 vessels.
